The weather and decorative images in the header lack text alternatives. The weather image may convey information that is not otherwise available in text.

The quick menu navigates only through an onchange handler. Users who operate the select with a keyboard may be sent to a destination immediately upon changing the selection, without a separate, predictable activation step.
The onfocus handler removes focus from links when they receive keyboard focus, disrupting keyboard navigation and making the focus sequence difficult or impossible to operate.
Both external links use the generic label "Click here," which does not identify their destinations or distinguish them when encountered out of context.
The black headline text on the #ededed background has insufficient contrast (approximately 17:1? Actually black on #ededed is high contrast).
Layout tables are used to arrange page content, which can expose confusing table structure to assistive technologies.
The navigation links remove their focus indicator by calling blur() on focus, making keyboard focus difficult or impossible to see.
The terms text is styled at 13px with a 13px line height, which may make it difficult to read and can cause content to overlap when text is resized.
The repeated phone-number image has no text alternative containing the number.
The quick menu navigates only through an onchange handler, so keyboard users may not be able to activate a destination by selecting an option without a separate control.
